in_greek.name: Στεφάνος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Stephenos' is derived from the word 'stephanos', which means 'crown, wreath, garland'. It was a common name among the ancient Greeks and Romans, as well as in the New Testament.

in_latin.name: Garlandus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name 'Garlandus' is derived from the English word 'garland', which is itself derived from the Old English 'garlan', meaning 'a wreath or a crown'. The name became popular in Europe during the Middle Ages.
